expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.lambda===405 && S.I===50 && S.metal==='Na' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: 405 nm, 50 %, natrium (must run before any setup)
on load: photon energy hc/λ = 3,06 eV (lesson-answers sim-load-E)
on load: E_k,max = 3,06 eV − 2,28 eV = 0,78 eV (sim-load-Ek)
on load: 0,4 · 50 = 20 electrons per second in the picture
on load: f = c/λ = 7,40e14 Hz (sim-load-f)
on load: E = 4,90e-19 J (ex-EJ)

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===2 && R[0].min==='200' && R[0].max==='700' && R[0].step==='5' && R[1].min==='0' && R[1].max==='100' && R[1].step==='10' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: two sliders: λ 200–700 nm in steps of 5; intensity 0–100 % in steps of 10
two selects: metal Na, Mg, Zn and speed hidas/normaali/nopea
DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='I,lambda,metal' && P.lambda.unit==='nm' && P.I.unit==='%' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares lambda (nm), I (%) and metal

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?850:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x850 (stacked, larger labels) under 500 px
the readout shows energies in eV and the frequency in Hz
